title: mallard list keys --format json, and the session's case.keys and keys.catalog

input.description: the case's input, or null for the catalog of every key

keys.description: by key path: type, dimension, unit, default or required, values, set (with an input), dims and set_in (without); a table's form: table, array (of tables, [[boundaries]]) or named (entries under names the input chooses, as [regions] and X)

complete.description: with an input: whether its setup read every key it reads

missing.description: with an input: required keys it does not set
